look.summary_zh: 中性 · 提亮中灰 · 中段跨度接近原值
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 135.3/255（变化 +7.8 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 0.957。中灰红减蓝 +0.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #EFD1C5、#D59985、#8F5441；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #D11230、#79CD0E、#4F33A2。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 135.3/255 (+7.8 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 0.957; mid-gray red minus blue +0.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #EFD1C5, #D59985, #8F5441. Red/green/blue swatches: #D11230, #79CD0E, #4F33A2.
look.suggested_use_zh: 产品、生活与风景对照试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
